concepts.name: 블루 티타늄
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent production-style PNG comparison candidate for the 10-year "Growing History" clan anniversary enamel badge.
Input image: approved bronze tree-shield badge, edit target. Preserve the entire design, silhouette, geometry, size, position and lighting. This must be the SAME badge with a different plating finish on the OUTERMOST thick shield border only.
CHANGE ONLY the wide continuous OUTER border metal. Keep the thin INNER border, five leaf shapes, emerald and mint enamel, ivory field, champagne-gold tree trunk, leaf dividers, roots, star and diamond EXACTLY as the original. Do not recolor or redesign any interior metal or enamel. No new ornaments or gems.
Composition: one large upright front-facing badge on the same square canvas, full shield visible, same scale and transparent safety margins as the input. Genuine transparent alpha background, no opaque rectangle, no checkerboard, no backdrop, no outside shadow, no labels, no text, no logos.
Quality: realistic premium sculpted hard-enamel jewelry, strong controlled metallic reflections and bevel depth. Keep sharp crisp geometry. The border must read as METAL, not painted plastic, not a flat solid-color stripe, not a neon light or glowing energy effect. Avoid stray colored pixels outside the silhouette.
OUTER BORDER FINISH: Deep polished cobalt-blue anodized titanium border. Saturated royal/cobalt blue body tone, slightly darker navy in recesses, restrained narrow cyan/teal reflections along bevels and clean pale blue-white specular highlights. Elegant and vivid enough to clearly distinguish from silver, gold and platinum, without a rainbow gradient or neon glow.
